mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which typically precedes improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months where INDPRO increases by at least 0.1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in consumer demand (RSAFS) and labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicates robust economic conditions that boost corporate profits and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS and UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases where UNRATE is below 4.0% and RSAFS is above its 12-month median.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), a positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates improving supply conditions that support corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), INDPRO increases are followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months where UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units indicate robust residential construction activity, which typically precedes higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of months where HOUST exceeds 1500, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), INDPRO increases are followed by negative 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases.
